name: Sintropix
long_description:
Sintropix is a financial system of record that closes your books every day and files your taxes in every country you operate in.

We connect to your banks, invoicing and payroll, and handle the accounting end-to-end. Founders get one place to do their finance work: track KPIs, see consolidated P&L and ARR reports, and forecast runway.

launches.tagline: End-to-end accounting for companies operating across borders
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re Alfonso and Borja - cofounders of Sintropix

**TL;DR**

Sintropix handles your accounting and taxes across countries, with a built-in financial system of record where you can run your company and track financial KPIs.\
\
<https://youtu.be/RPAwgAb5PDQ>
\
**The problem**

One entity in your home country is easy. Then you spin up a US parent to raise, or you expand abroad, and overnight you have two entities, two accounting firms, two sets of bank accounts, and a pile of spreadsheets nobody trusts. And you, as the founder, think about your finances in terms of one company, not separate entities. So the information your local accountant gives you makes no sense to you.

**What Sintropix does**

* **Gives you one source of truth** for your financial information. An audited general ledger
* **Closes the books for you**, only asking you when something's unclear
* **Produces reliable income statements and cash flow reports** consolidated across entities and currencies
* **Forecasts runway** in different hiring, revenue, and spend scenarios and see exactly how each hits your cash and runway
* **Prepares your taxes every month**. Yes, in some countries you file taxes every month.

**Why us**

We're brothers, and we've been building things together for 15 years.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125456&key=user_uploads/3532201/b8b34b35-2783-4939-b12d-9d9cdd8f20ea)

At 20, I started my first company and I couldn't afford an accountant, so I became one. I taught myself everything, down to filing our taxes. Later, I was employee #4 and Director of Product at [@Toku](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/24907) (YC S21), where I first hit this problem head-on: as we expanded into new markets, keeping a reliable view of finances got painful fast.

### **Our ask**

We are currently live in US, Mexico, Brazil and Chile (and expanding really fast into new markets). If you are a founder at a company operating in more than one country or you have multiple entities, we'd love to talk. 📩 [**founders@sintropix.com**](mailto:founders@sintropix.com)
